description: A Power Class Interoperable Multi-Coil Inductive Power Transfer System for 10/50 kW EV Charging: Experiment Video is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Patrick Lawton, Feiyang Lin (The University of Auckland). This experiment is from the paper "A Power Class Interoperable Multi-Coil Inductive Power Transfer System for 10/50 kW EV Charging", and presents an Inductive Power Transfer (IPT) system for Electric Vehicle (EV) charging with Power Class Interoperability (PCI) between the SAE WPT3 (10 kW) and WPT5 (50 kW) power classes using a multi-coil Bi-Polar Pad ... Coverage: not stated; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
